queries.query: Dutse Jigawa Nigeria official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry survey official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Jigawa State Ministry of Lands, Housing, Urban Development and Regional Planning, headquartered in Dutse, and its public Jigawa Land registry search page. The ministry describes registry, survey, deeds, land administration, and parcel survey functions. No public parcel geometry API was identified in the search results.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official ministry page fetched successfully; it exposed the Dutse custodian, registry/survey functions, and public search link, but no map viewer, parcel geometry, schema, or CRS route.

Official registry search page fetched successfully. Current JavaScript was inspected and exposes GET https://land.jg.gov.ng/search/results with file/plot/property/LGA search parameters; the page is a record search, not a published parcel geometry service.

Route responded with application/json when called without criteria.
